findings.prong1_is_not_a_length_test: Derived, and it is the finding under the finding: ADR-007's IBR_REMAINDER_MAX=300 was the obvious candidate and does NOT reproduce §b3 — intc-2002 item 5's only standalone content is 'As of February 21, 2003, there were approximately 240,000 registered holders of record of Intel's common stock.' = 110 chars, well under 300, and §b3 rejects it. Measured the same way ba-2003 item 5 is 308 and textron-2001 item 5 is 190, so the three rejections span 110..308 and no threshold separates them from xom item 8's 176. The discriminator is KIND: does the sentence dispose of any part of what the item requires, on its own, without the pointer?
